links.to_node: I do not prevent my colleague's server system upgrade.
My colleague proceeds with the server system upgrade.
The company's server system is offline for a few hours during the upgrade.
The company's operations experience a temporary halt during the server downtime.
The data processing speed of the company's server system improves slightly after the upgrade.
The scheduled maintenance by the server provider still causes additional downtime.
The company experiences two periods of server downtime: one from the upgrade and one from the scheduled maintenance.
